# Command reference

topdrawerx 0.5.0. Commands are case-insensitive and may be abbreviated to
the shortest unique prefix shown in **bold**; an ambiguous abbreviation is an
error that names the candidates.

A line of nothing but numbers is data. A line starting with `!`, `#` or `;` is a
comment, and `!` or `;` also start one part-way along a line.


## Commands

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| **ARR**OW<br>`ARROW <x0> <y0> <x1> <y1> \| ARROW UP\|DOWN\|LEFT\|RIGHT [LENGTH <n>]` | Draw an arrow, or one from each data point (upper limits). |
| **BOX**<br>`BOX [<x0> <y0> <x1> <y1>] [FILL]` | Draw a rectangle, or one per data point from the DX/DY columns. |
| **CASE**<br>`CASE '<case letters>'` | Apply legacy per-character character sets to the title just given. |
| **CLE**AR<br>`CLEAR` | Start a new frame keeping every setting, titles included. |
| **EXI**T<br>`EXIT` | Leave the program. |
| **FLU**SH<br>`FLUSH` | Throw away the data accumulated so far without drawing it. |
| **HEL**P<br>`HELP [<command>]` | List the commands, or explain one of them. |
| **HIST**OGRAM<br>`HISTOGRAM [FILL]` | Draw the data as a step histogram; X values are bin centres. |
| **HISTOR**Y<br>`HISTORY` | Show the commands that built the current picture. |
| **JOI**N<br>`JOIN [SOLID\|DASHES\|DOTS\|DOTDASH]` | Connect the data points with a line. |
| **LEG**END<br>`LEGEND '<text>' \| LEGEND [TOP\|BOTTOM] [LEFT\|RIGHT] \| LEGEND AT <x> <y> \| LEGEND OFF \| LEGEND BOX` | Name the thing just drawn, or place the key. |
| **LIS**T<br>`LIST [<n>]` | List the data points currently in the buffer (as in the original). |
| **MOR**E<br>`MORE '<text>'` | Add more text to the title just given. |
| **NEW**<br>`NEW FRAME \| NEW PAGE` | Start a new frame, or a new page. |
| **PL**OT<br>`PLOT [<symbol>]` | Draw the data as symbols, with error bars if DX/DY were given. |
| **QUI**T<br>`QUIT` | Leave the program. |
| **REA**D<br>`READ '<file>' [X Y DY ...]` | Fill the data buffer from a text or CSV file. |
| **SAV**E<br>`SAVE '<file.pdf\|.png\|.svg\|.tdx>' \| SAVE STYLE '<name>'` | Write the figure, the session as a runnable script, or the current style. |
| **SET**<br>`SET <property> <value> ...` | Change a graphics setting. |
| **SHO**W<br>`SHOW` | Show the current settings. |
| **STO**P<br>`STOP` | Leave the program (the original's word for it). |
| **TIT**LE<br>`TITLE [TOP\|BOTTOM\|LEFT\|RIGHT] '<text>' \| TITLE [FRAME] <x> <y> '<text>' [ANGLE n] [SIZE n] [CENTER]` | Label a side of the frame, or put text at a point on it. |
| **UND**O<br>`UNDO` | Remove the last command. |
| **ZON**E<br>`ZONE <columns> <rows> \| ZONE OFF` | Divide the page into equal cells, one frame per cell. |

## SET properties

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| SET **COL**OR<br>`SET COLOR <name>` | Set the drawing colour (any CSS/matplotlib colour name or #rrggbb). |
| SET **DEV**ICE<br>`SET DEVICE ...` | Accepted for compatibility; the output format comes from the file name. |
| SET **FIL**L<br>`SET FILL ON\|OFF` | Draw filled symbols instead of open ones. |
| SET **FON**T<br>`SET FONT [DUPLEX\|SIMPLEX\|<family>] [SIZE <points>]` | Choose the font family, and optionally the base text size. |
| SET **HAT**CH<br>`SET HATCH NONE\|DIAGONAL\|CROSS\|DOTS\|...` | Choose the shading pattern for filled areas (BOX, HISTOGRAM FILL). |
| SET **INT**ENSITY<br>`SET INTENSITY ...` | Accepted for compatibility; use SET WIDTH instead. |
| SET **LAB**ELS<br>`SET LABELS [SIZE <points>] [ALL\|X\|Y\|TOP\|...] [ON\|OFF] [PERMANENT]` | Size and per-side switching of the numeric axis labels. |
| SET **LIM**ITS<br>`SET LIMITS X <lo> <hi> [Y <lo> <hi>]` | Fix the axis ranges (X or Y AUTO returns an axis to automatic). |
| SET **ORD**ER<br>`SET ORDER X Y [DY] [DX]` | Name the columns of the numbers that follow. |
| SET **PAG**E<br>`SET PAGE <width> <height>   (inches)` | Set the page size in inches. |
| SET **PAL**ETTE<br>`SET PALETTE NONE\|OKABE\|BRIGHT\|GRAYS` | Cycle a colour per dataset.  SET COLOR turns cycling off again. |
| SET **PAT**TERN<br>`SET PATTERN SOLID\|DASHES\|DOTS\|DOTDASH` | Choose the line style for JOIN and HISTOGRAM. |
| SET **SC**ALE<br>`SET SCALE [X\|Y] LOG\|LINEAR` | Switch an axis between linear and logarithmic. |
| SET **SIZ**E<br>`SET SIZE <points>` | Set the symbol size in points. |
| SET **STY**LE<br>`SET STYLE <name>` | Load a style — a saved set of SET commands.  SET STYLE with no name lists them. |
| SET **SYM**BOL<br>`SET SYMBOL <name>\|<legacy code, e.g. 5O>` | Choose the plotting symbol, by name or by legacy marker code. |
| SET **TIC**KS<br>`SET TICKS [SIZE <inches>] [LONG <ratio>] [IN\|OUT] [ALL\|X\|Y\|TOP\|...] [ON\|OFF] [PERMANENT]` | Size, direction and per-side switching of the tick marks. |
| SET **WID**TH<br>`SET WIDTH <points>` | Set the line width in points. |
| SET **WIN**DOW<br>`SET WINDOW X <x0> TO <x1> Y <y0> TO <y1>   (inches) \| SET WINDOW OFF` | Place this frame exactly, in inches on the page. |

## Styles

`SET STYLE <name>` runs the `SET` commands in a style file. Built in:
`classic`, `notebook`, `paper`, `poster`, `talk`.

Your own styles live in `~/.config/tdx/styles/` (or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tdx/styles/`)
and shadow built-ins of the same name. `SAVE STYLE '<name>'` writes the current
settings there.

## Legacy compatibility

`SET DEVICE` and `SET INTENSITY` are accepted, warned about and ignored. A
command topdrawerx does not know is skipped with a note rather than aborting the
file; `--strict` turns that off, and `tdx --check <files>` reports what a pile of
old files would need.
